name: Niue
facts: Self-governing in free association with New Zealand

flag.description: A golden yellow field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist corner; the Union Jack carries five yellow stars, a larger one in a blue disc at its centre and four small ones on the arms of the red cross.
flag.symbolism: Yellow stands for the bright sun and the warm feelings of Niueans towards New Zealand; the four small stars are the Southern Cross and the larger star in the blue disc is Niue itself.

hook: Niue is the sunny one: the Union Jack on a bright yellow field instead of blue, with five little gold stars pinned onto the Jack itself.
trivia: Niue is one of the world's largest raised coral islands, nicknamed "the Rock of Polynesia".
Niueans are New Zealand citizens, and far more of them live in New Zealand than on Niue.
